artifacts.summary: Four-phase quarantine plan implementing the research report's corrected triage: MOVE nine confirmed-dead scripts to deprecated/ with per-file README rationale and same-substep manifest.provides.scripts drops; repair lint-contract-compliance.sh's broken root resolution and wire it as a new verify-deploy.sh gate; land keep-with-doc-note documentation for the four manual operator tools and the native rules frontmatter auto-load mechanism plus the dead .syncprotect line removal; close with a --wipe deploy sweep and full gate run.

memory_candidates.content: Quarantining a dead script in this agent-system repo is a two-part atomic edit, never a move alone: the file goes to <extension>/scripts/deprecated/ AND its manifest.json provides.scripts entry is dropped in the same substep, or the manifest-driven deploy engine fails on a missing declared path. Two mechanical facts make this pattern lint-clean: check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q (check_undeclared_scripts) explicitly skips deprecated/*, so the moved file is invisible to the undeclared-script check; and Rule M's deployed-orphan check enumerates via `git ls-files .claude/<category>`, which returns nothing because .claude/ is gitignored, so stale deployed copies of a de-declared script do NOT trip doc-lint. verify.lua's category parity is declared->deployed only, so dropping an entry cannot break that gate either. The consequence: no automated gate observes the stale deployed copy, and deploy-headless.sh's default mode (manager.resync_all) never removes anything -- proving a quarantined file is gone from .claude/ requires deploy-headless.sh --wipe specifically.
